title: clearStorageData leaves target partition localstorage intact
body: session.fromPartition('persist:alpha').clearStorageData({storages:['localstorage']}) leaves alpha's own stored keys intact. Other partitions are unchanged.

title: clearStorageData clears cookies despite selecting localstorage
body: Within the same persist:alpha partition, clearStorageData({storages:['localstorage']}) also removes cookies. Other partitions are unchanged.
